feature_contract.goal: Keep the complete original stage +TIME sprite and numeric glyph presentation on one source-owned per-eye rendering transaction, preventing a changed physical source from being replayed as a foreign right-eye HUD draw.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the native R84 exact +TIME ScreenHud physical-source fences in R30 XYZRHW, R30 shader finite-eye plane and R33 native shader draw; preserve the original six producer calls and unchanged timer, GOAL, F11, world, FFB, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original game six stage extension CALLs (three sprite and three number) retain exact StageExtensionTime ownership across direct and queued native command entry.
R84 R30 XYZRHW and shader finite-eye plus R33 shader paths capture native physical source, submit LEFT then reject a changed c64, pose, draw serial or SpriteNode queue epoch before RIGHT.
Only the same native physical producer can issue RIGHT-eye drawing and reach stereo host composition, while unsafe ownership follows existing fallback and R29 invalidation.
subcomponents: Fence +TIME RIGHT draw after native D3D9 render-target, depth, viewport and c64 setters in both R30 fixed-function and shader screen-HUD branches.
Fence the corresponding R33 shader RIGHT after native state setters without transferring prior +TIME ownership to a nested or replaced draw.
Extend physical-source smoke for queued and direct producers with negative changes to raw WVP, pose epoch, top-level draw, GOAL producer and queue epoch.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A changed c64 write, pose epoch, nested draw, GOAL producer or recycled queue fails closed without granting the prepared RIGHT draw to another source.

diagnosis.original_evidence: +TIME native presentation has three original sprite and three numeric producer calls; D3DX replay and the R30/R33 physical HUD GPU paths are separate from producer hook lifetime.
source_trace: Original sprite/glyph StageExtensionTime token enters the R84 native R30 ScreenHud XYZRHW or shader finite-eye path through physical draw command metadata.
R30 can submit native LEFT then call D3D9 render-target/depth/viewport/WVP state setters that may reenter a different original game producer before RIGHT.
R33 has a parallel shader HUD native LEFT-to-RIGHT owner transaction, so its prepared RIGHT must also inspect the live physical source after state setup.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally classify stage sprites, force D3DX Flush, skip original LEFT, invent HMD pass, change GOAL timing or weaken unknown-producer and device-loss fallback.
diagnosis.root_cause: Earlier R84 exact +TIME physical source checks did not consistently fence live source after all right-eye native D3D9 state setters across XYZRHW, shader finite plane and R33 shader HUD branches.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material C++ commit 2dcb484071a5681fb5599c9e4690057bd2d68548 adds same-source physical validation at the R30 and R33 native right-eye state boundaries.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: vrhost/tests/stage_extension_eye_plane_smoke.cpp tests queued and direct unchanged positive cases and negative mutations to WVP write serial, pose epoch, top-level draw, GOAL producer and queue epoch.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Original LEFT and prepared RIGHT must share the same live raw WVP, draw/pose/queue producer identity; a source change invalidates pair and leaves existing safe fallback. Quest3/VDXR not exercised.
